document_strings: I was sent to Bermuda where I stayed until Oct. 12 1945 - I made many friends in the army -
My duties in the army walked & faintly they made me a 1st class gunner on a big gun - My best friend was John Pearls -
and also I met my Sgt. Fred Roderick -
I enjoyed my stay in Bermuda very much
When I was discharged from Ft. Monmouth New Jersey I was sent home to a empty house.
My mother had an nervous breakdown - Sidney Dubin - a candy store owner told me where she was -
She was in NURSING HOME IN ASTORIA Queens -
When I arrived there I saw her my mother was - I then asked the doctor because she was he told me not any good.
They HAD TO give her a shock treatment for many days -
When I saw her again she seemed better. She stayed there for about 1 year.
They sent her home on and off - finally she passed away Sept 16 - 1960 - in a hospital in Hempstead L.I.
